name: Torph
summary: Dependency-free text morphing component for React, Vue, Svelte and vanilla JS that animates text and numbers between states.
description: A small library that morphs text from one state to another by matching characters and animating them. Numbers morph by place value, typing fields can pass a caret position for position-based updates, and spring easing parameters are supported. Ships framework entry points for React, Vue, Svelte and vanilla JavaScript; demo examples cover copy buttons, live counters, chart readouts, reflowing paragraphs, streamed text and amount fields.
contains: framework entry points: React, Vue, Svelte and vanilla JavaScript
numbers morph by place value; caret position supported for typing fields
examples: copy buttons, live counters, chart readouts, streamed text, amount fields
